task: Iron / hepcidin homeostasis cert: the hepcidin-ferroportin axis (hepcidin binds ferroportin -> internalization/degradation -> blocks Fe export from enterocytes/macrophages), total body iron ~3-4g (~2/3 in hemoglobin), the near-closed-loop recycling economy (~20-25 mg/day recycled vs ~1-2 mg/day dietary absorption), and hepcidin regulation (up by iron+inflammation/IL-6->STAT3, down by erythropoietic drive/erythroferrone). Required falsifiers: (1) mass-balance (recycling >>> absorption, ~90-95% recycled fraction); (2) hepcidin response direction (IL-6 up->hepcidin up->hypoferremia; erythroferrone up->hepcidin down in stress erythropoiesis). Decorrelated check: HFE hemochromatosis (low/blunted hepcidin->overload) and the hepcidin-KO mouse phenocopy.
confidence_tier: in-vivo-anchored (Nemeth 2004 JCI human IL-6 infusion, paired hepcidin-fold-change + serum-iron-drop in the SAME subjects/timepoint; Kautz 2014 + Nicolas 2001 + Lesbordes-Brion 2006 mouse genetics; Bridle 2003 + Feder 1996 human HFE hemochromatosis; Ganz 2008 / Kroot 2009 human hepcidin-assay data) for the regulation-direction and decorrelated-check falsifiers; 3-independent-review-cross-checked (Muckenthaler 2017 Cell, Wang & Babitt 2019 Blood, Int J Mol Sci 2021 review) for the mass-balance figures, PLUS one independent geometric/stoichiometric derivation (this doc's own) that lands in the same band from unrelated sibling-doc inputs; standard protein-chemistry-stoichiometry tier for the Hb/heme molecular-weight constants; disclosed STRUCTURAL (not literature-fit) parameters for the WT iron-sensing gain magnitude, the log-linear multi-signal combination, and the dietary-excess ratio in the decorrelated-check ODE.

overall_verdict.f1_mass_balance: PASS -- Hb-bound iron independently DERIVED (2.60 g, stoichiometry x sibling-doc Hb/blood-volume) lands inside the literature's 2-3 g band; recycling flux independently DERIVED (22.6 mg/day, pool/RBC-lifespan) lands inside the literature's 20-25 mg/day band (triple-sourced); recycled fraction = 93.8%, inside the task's own pre-registered 90-95% band; adversary (lifespan sweep 60-140d, Hb sweep 8-18 g/dL) forced and shown to fall -- recycling-dominance (>85%) holds across 100% of both swept ranges, i.e. the conclusion is not a fragile point-estimate artifact
overall_verdict.f2_hepcidin_response_direction: PASS -- IL-6 arm calibrated to Nemeth2004JCI's own paired human numbers (7.5x hepcidin -> 34% serum-iron drop, same subjects/timepoint), reconciled exactly by a single-free-parameter (Kd, n=1 no-cooperativity) hyperbolic ferroportin response, disclosed as a functional-form consistency check not an independent magnitude validation; ERFE arm built on the CORRECTED (live full-text re-check caught an initial wrong assumption) genotype-comparative direction from Kautz2014 -- WT defends more plasma iron than a KO-scenario, matching the real WT-unchanged-vs-KO-below-baseline data, with the absolute-level gap (demand-side/erythropoietic-consumption term not modeled) explicitly disclosed
overall_verdict.f4_decorrelated_check_HFE_hepcidin_KO: PASS -- a time-integrated mass-balance ODE with ONE literature-anchored parameter changed (iron-sensing gain attenuated 5.4x, Bridle2003's own measured HAMP-mRNA reduction) shows WT converging inside the literature's normal 3-4g band (3.75g) while HFE converges OUTSIDE its upper edge (4.82g, ratio 1.28x); forced adversary (nuisance +/-30% wobble on diet/loss/ceiling under INTACT gain, 60 draws) shows its WORST-CASE draw (4.21g) still falls short of the specific mechanism's level (4.82g) -- generic parameter noise does not reproduce the disease-level effect, a MINORITY (~1-in-5) nudging slightly over the literature's own upper edge is honestly disclosed, not hidden
overall_verdict.symmetric_qc_held_open_per_task_instruct: Iron pools/turnover vary by sex/age/diet/altitude/pregnancy -- all point estimates here are adult-reference-population medians, not subject-specific (same convention as the sibling erythropoiesis.py's Nadler-1962 blood-volume constant). Hepcidin assay is genuinely context-dependent via TWO separate, disclosed, non-conflated sources of variance: biological (Ganz 2008's own healthy-volunteer range spans 29-254 ng/mL men / 17-286 ng/mL women, >8-fold, PLUS a documented diurnal rhythm) and measurement-method (Kroot 2009's 8-lab round robin: absolute concentrations differ widely across assay methods even though each method is internally precise). A real structural limitation is also disclosed: this doc's single 'storage' compartment does not resolve the parenchymal-vs-reticuloendothelial redistribution Nicolas2001 documents in hepcidin-null mice (splenic iron LOWER even as total body iron rises) -- overload is not a uniform rise across all compartments.
